Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE acceptance(request TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES requests(id),evidence TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,operation TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(id),quantity INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(quantity>0))

Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE admissions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,operation TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(id))

Schema.Name: alarms
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE alarms(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,code TEXT NOT NULL,scope TEXT NOT NULL,active INTEGER NOT NULL,json TEXT NOT NULL)

Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE attempts(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,request TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES requests(id),ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,json TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(request,ordinal))

Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE audit(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,owner TEXT NOT NULL,at TEXT NOT NULL,json TEXT NOT NULL)

Schema.Name: commands

Schema.Name: configs
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE configs(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,status TEXT NOT NULL,json TEXT NOT NULL)

Schema.Name: observations
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE observations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,device TEXT NOT NULL,epoch TEXT NOT NULL,source TEXT NOT NULL,operation TEXT REFERENCES operations(id),json TEXT NOT NULL,UNIQUE(device,epoch,source))

Schema.Name: operations
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE operations(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,session TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions(id),lane TEXT NOT NULL,created TEXT NOT NULL,json TEXT NOT NULL)

Schema.Name: schema_history
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE schema_history(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,checksum TEXT NOT NULL,applied TEXT NOT NULL)

Schema.Name: sessions
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE sessions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,json TEXT NOT NULL)

Schema.Name: state
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE state(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1), json TEXT NOT NULL)

Schema.Name: storage_format
Schema.Sql: CREATE TABLE storage_format(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),version INTEGER NOT NULL,minimum_reader INTEGER NOT NULL)
